findings.title: Step 7 sends the committee to the class analytics, roster and student detail without saying the cohort is generated demonstration data
findings.evidence: Faculty guest 'Class intelligence' (w-d-s7-faculty.png): 'Students 38 / Completion 73% / Needs attention 5 / Where learners get stuck: Acid-Base Emergency 59% ... / roster Inès Moreau 94% ... Marie Dubois 55% Accuracy under 60%'. grep of web/src: the only 'prepared demonstration data / not real people' notice is web/src/pages/student.tsx:63 (student dashboard) and the reset dialog; no faculty page (analytics, student detail, content review) and nothing on the About page says the 38 students, their names and figures are synthetic (be/src/demo.ts: 'Every number ... is produced by playing the real game with a controlled clock'; 38-student class with invented names). Step 7 text: 'Show the class analytics, the roster, a student detail and the Content review.' 'Before you present' says only that 'the demo student is prepared'.
findings.repro: Student guest > About > step 7 > Faculty guest > Class intelligence; read the page as a committee member who has not seen the student dashboard note.
findings.expected: A page shown to an academic committee states that the class, the 38 learners, accuracy/completion figures and 'needs attention' flags are generated demonstration data, not results from real students (and so say nothing about pedagogical effectiveness or real cohorts).
findings.actual: Nothing on the About page or on the faculty screens says so. Realistic names plus 'Where learners get stuck', '59%' and 'Needs attention' can be read as real class data or as evidence of use; a skeptical academic will ask 'which class is this?'.
findings.fix_hint: Add to 'Before you present' and to step 7 purpose: 'The class of 38 students, their names and all figures are generated demonstration data, not real learners.' Ideally add the same one-line note on the faculty dashboard.

findings.title: Step 5 hint says Blood Smear Code 'cannot host a retry'; it can (wrong answer, 2 hints, retry)
findings.evidence: demo-guide.ts step 5 hint: 'Blood Smear Code ends on its first correct answer, so it cannot host a retry.' Real app (bsc.mjs, bsc-wrong.png): Blood Smear Code, click a wrong place + Submit answer -> 'Not quite. Look for fragments, not whole cells... XP penalty: -10.', mission stays open, 'Hints used on this step: 0 of 2', 'Ask Lab Assistant' available; a second click + submit then completes. API: POST /attempts/:id/answer with a wrong point returns correct:false, penaltyXp -10, then a correct point returns completed:true.
findings.repro: About > Open the Hematology lab > Replay Blood Smear Code > click away from the schistocyte > Submit answer; then Ask Lab Assistant.
findings.expected: Statement true: the mission ends on the first correct answer, but it does allow a wrong answer, a hint (-15 XP) and a retry.
findings.actual: Page tells the presenter the 60-second step-3 mission is useless for the step-5 demonstration, which is false; an academic (or a presenter who tries it) sees the contradiction.
findings.fix_hint: Say 'Blood Smear Code has a single step, so the mission ends as soon as the answer is right; Fix the Sample has three samples and shows the retry more clearly.'

findings.title: 'A replay adds XP to the shared demo student' is imprecise and understates what a rehearsal changes
findings.evidence: game.ts complete(): XP is added only when the new score beats mission_best. Fresh seeded DB: replay Blood Smear Code in a few seconds -> 'New personal best: +12 XP' (8,252 XP); replay Fix the Sample (105 XP after hint + mistake) -> 'This replay did not beat your best score, so your total XP is unchanged.' A second Blood Smear Code replay adds 0. Student detail after rehearsal shows 8,252 XP and extra attempts in the history (historyTotal 6 -> more), plus hint/accuracy counters.
findings.repro: Replay both missions as in steps 3-5, then open Faculty > Student detail > Alex Martin.
findings.expected: 'A replay can add XP (only when it beats the best score) and adds attempts to the student's history.'
findings.actual: Page says a replay adds XP (not always true) and does not mention history/accuracy/hint counters, which the faculty step then shows to the committee.
findings.fix_hint: 'A replay may raise the XP total and always adds an attempt to the shared demo student's history, until the next reset.'

findings.title: 'Before you present' is not role-aware and gives no recovery after an accidental Mark reviewed
findings.evidence: The block is rendered unchanged in the Faculty guest, where 'Reset guest session' does not exist (sticky.mjs: teacher role, Reset guest session 'absent' at every width). After UI 'Mark reviewed' on Blood Smear Code, the student 'Reset guest session' restores XP 8,240 / history 6 / no attempt in progress but Content review keeps 'reviewed' (state.sh). The UI can undo it (Mark reviewed > Approve > Return to draft; cycle.mjs) but the row then reads 'Now draft · Oct 8, 2026, 10:11 PM' instead of 'No review recorded yet', and the same trace remains after the API teacher reset (append-only audit).
findings.repro: Faculty guest > About > read 'Before you present'; or click Mark reviewed on any row, then follow the block.
findings.expected: Block tells a Faculty-guest reader to 'Return to student demo' first, and says how to put a row back to Draft (Approve, then Return to draft) and that a trace remains.
findings.actual: Instruction cannot be executed as written from the Faculty guest; 'The Faculty-side reset is not available in the interface' offers no remedy although a partial one exists.
findings.fix_hint: Add 'If you are in the Faculty guest, choose Return to student demo first.' and 'If a row was changed, use Approve then Return to draft; a dated trace remains.'

findings.title: Time budget (390 s) omits about 25 navigations; a realistic run is 7 to 7:30, longer on a phone
findings.evidence: Step budgets 30+30+60+60+60+45+75+30 = 390 s = 6 min 30. Measured machine time of all clicks/loads is about 12 s (times: 0.4, 0.17, 0.32, 0.93, 0.28, 1.17, 0.94, 1.24, 2.27, 1.14 s), but the guide needs About re-opened 6 times (after each mission result and each guest switch), roughly 25-28 clicks in all, plus reading the mission screens. My estimate for a competent presenter: 6:45-7:15 desktop, 7:15-7:45 at 375 px (page is 6,776 px tall; Guest options menu for the switch and the return). Stopping Fix the Sample right after the retry saves about 25 s but then the 'server records the score and the time' result screen of step 5 is not seen.
findings.repro: Follow steps 1-8 at 1440x900 and 375x812 (walk.mjs, w-d-*.png, w-m-*.png).
findings.actual: Fits only at the top of the range.
findings.fix_hint: Either say 'about 7 minutes' or mark step 2 (30 s) and the end of Fix the Sample as optional.

findings.title: Step 3 title 'Start one biomedical mission' contradicts its own body ('replay')
findings.evidence: Step 3 h3 'Start one biomedical mission'; body 'replay the mission Blood Smear Code'; the picker button says 'Replay' and the result says 'New personal best'. Same for step 4 ('The decision-making flow' is fine).
findings.expected: Title consistent with what the presenter does.

findings.title: Image provenance: the page is now careful, but the in-app caption and two docs still assert an origin
findings.evidence: Page foot: 'provenance and licensing still have to be documented' (good). In the mission screen (bsc-wrong.png): 'Stylised blood smear, created for training.' README: 'illustrative training artwork'; docs/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md: 'All images are illustrative artwork'; docs/SCIENTIFIC_REVIEW_BACKLOG.md C-07: no source/licence for blood-smear-hero.webp. The committee sees the caption two clicks after the page says provenance is undocumented.
findings.repro: Replay Blood Smear Code and read the caption under the image.
findings.expected: Same level of claim everywhere shown or handed to the committee.
findings.actual: Caption and docs say 'created for training / artwork'.
findings.fix_hint: Caption: 'Illustrative image for training. Not a real specimen, not validated, not for clinical use.' and align README/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.

findings.title: Roadmap: who plans the five phases and the institution roles in 'Proposed academic direction' are not documented anywhere in the repo
findings.evidence: ROADMAP_LOOP: Create/Monastir, Observe & Learn/HEPL-Liège, Validate & Transfer/Monastir. docs/SCIENTIFIC_REVIEW_BACKLOG.md 5.4 proposes a pilot at BOTH Monastir and HEPL and says it must go to the ethics bodies of both institutions; no document assigns these three roles or the phases A-E (E 'Refinement and transfer' has no source). The page hedges ('proposal, not an agreement ... still have to be confirmed', 'planned, not agreed or approved'), which is acceptable.
findings.repro: Scroll to 'Scientific validation roadmap'; grep docs/README/be/src.
findings.expected: Owner confirms the loop wording before the Erasmus committee sees it.
findings.actual: Hedged but unsourced; 'Five phases are planned' does not say by whom.
findings.fix_hint: Confirm with the project owner; consider 'Five phases are proposed' instead of 'planned'.

walkthrough.database_preparation: Rehearsal tested end to end on a fresh seeded DB at 1440 and 375: after replays (XP 8,252, extra history rows) and an abandoned in-progress mission, student guest 'Reset guest session' -> 'Confirm reset' (phone: Guest options > Reset guest session > Confirm reset; about 0.8 s, lands on home) > click 'About & demo guide' restored Alex Martin level 6, 8,240 XP, 5 of 9 missions, Hematology completed (3 of 3, exit unlocked), Microbiology 2 of 3, continue = Petri Dish Mystery with resume:false (no mission in progress), history 6 attempts. Content review is NOT restored by that reset (a 'reviewed' row stayed reviewed). To restore it: API teacher token POST /api/demo/reset (all rows Draft, tested), or in the UI Mark reviewed > Approve > Return to draft (row reads 'Now draft · date' afterwards, a trace remains). API commands: T=$(curl -s -XPOST http://HOST/api/auth/demo -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"role":"student"}' | jq -r .token); curl -XPOST http://HOST/api/demo/reset -H "authorization: Bearer $T"; repeat with {"role":"teacher"}. Fresh-DB alternative: delete the DB and run be/scripts/seed-demo.ts.
